pattern: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.
criterion: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.

lesson.title: State Unknown Product And Callback History As Uncertain
lesson.when: A user mentions a scheduled callback or product inquiry without documented sources or context for the specific product or appointment
lesson.do: Acknowledge the outreach using only verified source details and express uncertainty about unverified specifics
lesson.otherwise: Avoid assuming specific SKUs, product names, or scheduled context not backed by evidence
